title: Surface the focused launcher recognizer's rejection reason instead of silently treating the command as not a test
outcome: Surface the focused launcher recognizer's rejection reason instead of silently treating the command as not a test
acceptance: When a launcher-shaped command is rejected by engram_focused_launcher_words (for example an unsupported or duplicate option), the computed reason reaches a readable place (the run's registration or check-recognition diagnostics) and names the option and the supported form, instead of the command silently becoming 'not a test'; shown by a behaviour test.
Recognition outcomes for valid commands are unchanged.
